title: Enhanced antibacterial and antioxidant capabilities using indole-modified 1-phenyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine-5-carbonitrile derivatives, molecular docking evaluation and in silico ADMET prediction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47255-47270
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07372C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hemat S. Khalaf, Ahmed F. El-Sayed, Ahmed H. Shamroukh
A series of 1-phenyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine-5-carbonitriles were synthesized and characterized. The compounds showed notable antimicrobial activity against major bacterial strains and exhibited antioxidant potential in the DPPH assay.
